strings.unit.worker.name: Baker
strings.unit.worker.desc: A little baker. Gathers flour faster.
strings.unit.melee_basic.name: Toast
strings.unit.melee_basic.desc: Toast Knight. Cheap, quick-to-deploy basic melee soldier.
strings.unit.ranged_basic.name: Roll
strings.unit.ranged_basic.desc: Roll Thrower. Hurls bread rolls from the back line. Low HP.
strings.unit.tank.name: Loaf
strings.unit.tank.desc: Loaf Shield. Tough and slow. Holds the front line.
strings.unit.fast.name: Twist
strings.unit.fast.desc: Pretzel Rider. Rushes ahead and strikes rapidly.
strings.unit.siege.name: Oven
strings.unit.siege.desc: Oven Cannon. Slow, but deals heavy damage to bases and groups.
strings.hero.hero_captain.name: Head Baker
strings.hero.hero_captain.desc: Leader of the Bakery Knights. Speeds up nearby allies' attacks.
strings.skill.skill_slam.name: Slam
strings.skill.skill_slam.desc: Smash the enemies in front with a rolling pin and knock them back.
strings.skill.skill_rally.name: Rally
strings.skill.skill_rally.desc: A fresh-baked battle cry. Briefly boosts nearby allies' attack and speed.
strings.skill.skill_barrage.name: Barrage
strings.skill.skill_barrage.desc: After a short delay, rains crumb shells on a large area far ahead.
strings.skill.skill_flour.name: Flour Drop
strings.skill.skill_flour.desc: Get 90 flour at once to send more troops.
strings.skill.skill_shield.name: Sugar Barrier
strings.skill.skill_shield.desc: Nearby allies get a shield worth 25% of max HP for 6 s.
strings.skill.skill_frost.name: Frost Cream
strings.skill.skill_frost.desc: Chills the enemy front for 5 s: much slower moves and attacks. Bosses half as much.
strings.skill.skill_oven.name: Oven Heat
strings.skill.skill_oven.desc: Fire on the road ahead of the hero for 3 s, hitting several times.

strings.tut_deploy_unit: Tap the Toast card to send a soldier.
strings.tut_buy_worker: Tap Baker to hire one. Bakers gather flour faster.
strings.tut_destroy_base: Destroy the Mold Nest on the far right to win!
strings.tut_skill_slam: When you have enough energy, tap the skill button to Slam.
strings.tut_ranged_unit: Rolls are strongest behind a front line.
strings.tut_tank_unit: Put Loaf Shields in front to block the spore-spitting enemies.
strings.tut_skill_rally: Use Rally to empower your army.
strings.tut_fast_unit: Twists rush in and hit the nearest enemy first. Send them with your front line.
strings.tut_boss_warning: A leader of the Mold Legion approaches!
strings.tut_siege_unit: Ovens deal 3× damage to the Mold Nest.
strings.tut_bomber_warning: Yeast Puffs burst on contact. Kill them from range.
strings.tut_skill_barrage: Barrage wipes out incoming crowds at once!

strings.unit.e_guard.name: Husk Guard
strings.unit.e_guard.desc: Armored frontline. Break its shell with heavy hits.
strings.unit.e_runner.name: Dust Runner
strings.unit.e_runner.desc: Fast raider. Keep it away from the bakery.
strings.unit.e_mortar.name: Spore Mortar
strings.unit.e_mortar.desc: Long-range splash fire. Close in with your hero and raiders.
strings.unit.boss_millward.name: Mill Warden
strings.unit.boss_millward.desc: A checkpoint boss backed by reinforcements. Hold the frontline.
strings.unit.boss_rootking.name: Root King
strings.unit.boss_rootking.desc: A checkpoint boss backed by reinforcements. Hold the frontline.
strings.unit.boss_frostguard.name: Frost Warden
strings.unit.boss_frostguard.desc: A shelled checkpoint boss. It alternates a charge and a frost slam, and its shell opens only right after each.
strings.unit.boss_ovenheart.name: Mold Oven Heart
strings.unit.boss_ovenheart.desc: A checkpoint boss backed by reinforcements. Hold the frontline.

strings.unit.e_thrall.name: Hypha Thrall
strings.unit.e_thrall.desc: Slams hard once the ground marker fills. Step out of the marker, then strike while it recovers.
strings.unit.e_binder.name: Hypha Knot
strings.unit.e_binder.desc: Stays behind the front and shields allies with hyphae. Cut the knot with a skill and the bound enemies are briefly exposed.
strings.unit.boss_nestcore.name: Nest Core
strings.unit.boss_nestcore.desc: Barely hurt while a knot holds it. Cut every knot and it stops, exposed. As it weakens it calls knots in pairs; at the end it can call none and only repeats its slam.
strings.toast.enemy_heavy: A heavy attack lands when the ground marker fills!
strings.toast.boss_heavy: The boss is winding up a slam!
strings.toast.core_exposed: The core is exposed! Focus it now!
strings.toast.boss_phase2: The core calls two knots to wrap itself. Cut them all!
strings.toast.boss_phase3: The core can call no more knots. Dodge the slam, strike the opening!

strings.round.r32.name: Staggered Slams
strings.round.r33.name: The First Knot
strings.round.r34.name: Rolling Tremors
strings.round.r35.name: Entangled Escort
strings.round.r36.name: Twin Knots
strings.round.r37.name: Spore Cover
strings.round.r38.name: Living Thread
strings.round.r39.name: Before the Core
strings.round.r40.name: The Nest Core
strings.unit.e_frostshell.name: Frost Carapace
strings.unit.e_frostshell.desc: Barely hurt while its shell is shut. Strike when it stops and opens, or force it open with a hero skill.
strings.unit.e_icerunner.name: Rime Charger
strings.unit.e_icerunner.desc: Marks a path, then rams the first target standing on it. Step the hero off the path or take it on a cheap front unit.
strings.unit.e_sporesac.name: Ferment Sac
strings.unit.e_sporesac.desc: Swells, then lobs a spore clump; the marked ground bursts a moment later. Hit it while it swells, or clear the marked spot and wait.
strings.unit.e_burrower.name: Hypha Burrower
strings.unit.e_burrower.desc: Digs under your front line. It surfaces where the dirt trail stops: send the hero back or meet it with fresh troops.
strings.toast.enemy_vent: It only takes real damage while its shell is open!
strings.toast.enemy_charge: It will ram the first target on the marked path!
strings.toast.enemy_lob: The marked ground is about to burst!
strings.toast.enemy_burrow: An enemy went underground. Follow the dirt trail!
strings.hint.loss.no_units: No soldiers were sent. Tap a soldier card to hold the line.
strings.hint.loss.flour_idle: Flour sat full. Send soldiers more often.
strings.hint.loss.no_baker: No baker was hired. Hiring early makes flour come faster.
strings.hint.loss.hero_fell: The hero fell several times. Keep the hero behind the soldiers and off danger markers.
strings.hint.loss.no_skill: Energy was left over. Use a skill when enemies bunch up.
strings.unit.baguette.name: Baguette
strings.unit.baguette.desc: Baguette lancer. Its long baguette spear strikes before the enemy can reach. Best right behind a shield.
strings.unit.macaron.name: Macaron
strings.unit.macaron.desc: Macaron sniper. Hits hard, one shot at a time, from very far away. Slow and fragile, so keep a front line ahead.
strings.unit.chili.name: Cake
strings.unit.chili.desc: Cake creamer. Its whipped-cream burst splatters every enemy packed together. Bring it out when a swarm is coming.
strings.unit.donut.name: Donut
strings.unit.donut.desc: Donut guardian. Thick dough armour soaks hits and shoves enemies back. Weak attack, so send shooters behind it.
strings.unit.waffle.name: Waffle
strings.unit.waffle.desc: Waffle sieger. Lobs waffle chunks from afar that wreck the enemy base. Ordinary against soldiers, and costly.
